mentions.name: Personal software cleanup and modernization
mentions.description: This project removes hacky, maintenance-heavy customized software from the author's life and aggressively modernizes the few projects kept, deleting thousands of lines of original code and adding many times more tests, so that maintaining a custom note taking app no longer acts as a second part-time job.
mentions.problem: Hacky DIY software required constant upkeep, effectively a second part-time job of maintenance.
mentions.source_excerpt: I focused on getting rid of hacky DIY things that needed maintenance. I got rid of almost all the customized software in my life, and the few projects I decided to keep, I aggressively modernized, getting rid of thousands of lines of original code and adding many times more tests than I'd ever had before.
